title: Gym Promo With Visit Details
tests: Tests accurate, phone-readable address and opening-hours overlays held long enough to use in a short local-business ad.

faults.what: The audio contains intelligible, unrelated speech despite the explicit request for no voiceover.

judge.summary: The vertical gym promo looks welcoming and displays readable, accurate details, but unwanted speech requires an audio redo.

must_haves.item: The visuals depict a welcoming gym rather than an intimidating bodybuilding-focused environment.
must_haves.why: Bright interiors, smiling people and a group exercise class convey an approachable gym.

must_haves.item: The text reads exactly 'Northside Gym', '18 Cedar Road', 'Mon–Fri 6am–10pm' and 'Sat–Sun 8am–6pm'.
must_haves.why: All required wording is readable and correct; the weekday hours wrap across two visual lines.

must_haves.item: All four text lines are visible together continuously during the final 5 seconds.
must_haves.why: All four details appear together at 6.3 and 8.8 seconds, but the supplied frames cannot establish uninterrupted visibility from 5 to 10 seconds.

must_haves.item: The details are large, high-contrast and fully inside the frame, with no overlapping or clipped characters.
must_haves.why: Large white text on a dark translucent panel is fully within the frame and has no overlapping or clipped characters.

must_haves.item: The finished promo is vertical, lasts approximately 10 seconds, and includes upbeat music without voiceover.
must_haves.why: The format is vertical and the reported duration is 10 seconds, but the audio transcript confirms unwanted speech. The music's mood cannot be judged from the supplied information.
